name: Ordinary legitimate activity
description: Routine account access and occasional transfers.

name: Benign shared public infrastructure
description: Several legitimate accounts use one public IP; sharing alone should not trigger high risk.

name: Shared device with additional suspicious context
description: Multiple accounts share a device and show tightly timed access and transfers.

name: Common beneficiary concentration
description: Multiple accounts transfer to a common synthetic beneficiary in a short interval.

name: Rapid coordinated activity
description: A set of accounts generate closely timed sessions and transfers.

name: Ambiguous mixed infrastructure
description: Shared network signal plus otherwise mixed activity; requires human review.

name: Impersonation-linked account takeover
description: An established account shows unfamiliar access followed by transfers to a new beneficiary. This is an investigation lead, not proof of impersonation.
